newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast prods edge up on NYMEX, coker news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast prods edge up on NYMEX, coker news.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices edged up late Wednesday, tracking a stronger futures market and rumors of a coker outage in Los Angeles.
Unleaded gasoline for October delivery jumped about 1.06 cents a gallon to 65.91 cents, while heating oil rose 1.52 cents a gallon to close at 68.19.
Supply jitters went through distillate markets when Arco confirmed rumors that a coker in Los Angeles would stay shut another 10 days following problems which began last week.
The 42,000 barrel-per-day coker affected crude runs at the refinery, which fell from 260,000 bpd to 190,000 bpd.
